scope: Literal selected source text, byte/character offsets, numeric/year identities and retained/omitted partitions independently recomputed from existing raw captures. No original annotations, labels, evidence lists or source bank read. True token counts recorded by actual worker, not independently retokenized. Numeric omission and retrieval misses never prove absence or insufficient evidence; this is provenance, not arithmetic or semantic numerical reasoning. Repeated numeric occurrences across per-hypothesis contexts are not unique-document totals.
